_comment: Reviewed license exceptions for scripts/check-licenses.py (ADR-0003). One entry per package, exact version: a version bump re-opens the review. Every entry needs a written reason; an entry that matches no package fails the check. 'license' is what the package really carries; 'vendor_terms': true marks a vendor's own non-SPDX terms, reviewed by name; any other license must be an allowed SPDX id, and an override never lifts a license the tool read as denied or MPL-2.0. 'scopes' limits where the entry applies (src, tests, other).
